# What the leak check refuses: paths that are specific to one machine.
# Each line that is not blank and does not start with # is one literal string, and a line of a
# checked file that holds any of them is reported.
# Standard locations, the same on every Mac, are left out so they pass: ~/.claude/, ~/.android/.
# This file is public. A private folder whose name should stay private goes in a file of its own,
# given to the check with --scope.
/Users/
~/temp
$HOME/temp
